description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for different LLaMA-2 models with varying sizes and fine-tuning configurations. The horizontal axis represents the model sizes, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model size is associated with a group of three bars, colored blue, purple, and red, representing "+ SFT on D0", "+ SFT on D0, D1", and "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" respectively. The blue bars have approximate values of 68, 70, and 81 for the three model sizes; the purple bars have values of around 80, 86, and 82; and the red bars have values of approximately 84, 80, and 84. The bars within each group are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. The chart provides a visual representation of how the CoLeG-R percentage varies across different model sizes and fine-tuning configurations.
